summary: Russian forces launched a large-scale missile and UAV attack targeting Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian regions, with over 20 missiles and numerous Shahed drones reported. Ukrainian defense forces struck two major power substations in occupied Crimea, causing blackouts in Saki, Yevpatoria, and parts of Bakhchisarai district. Heavy fighting continues in Konstantinovka where Russian forces have approached the outskirts and proposed a tactical ceasefire which Ukrainian analysts assess as a trap.
key_points: Russian missile groups launched from Chernihiv and Poltava regions toward Kyiv, with over 20 rockets reported heading to Brovary and Boryspil. (Source: @eRadarrua/99867)
Ukrainian air defenses engaged Shahed drones over northern Kyiv districts and cruise missiles over Chernihiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68584, @mon1tor_ua/68616)
Russian forces struck a gas station in Izium, Kharkiv region, killing one man and causing fires. (Source: @UkraineNow/82427)
Ukrainian strikes on Crimean substations left Saki, Yevpatoria, and parts of Bakhchisarai district without power. (Source: @UkraineNow/82423)
Russian tactical aviation active on eastern and northeastern fronts, posing aviation weapon threat to frontline areas. (Source: @kpszsu/67483, @kpszsu/67489)
Sumy OVA warned of planned Russian strikes on gas stations in Sumy region. (Source: @UkraineNow/82429)
Russian Defense Ministry claims Ukraine refused to retrieve bodies of servicemen from Konstantinovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31398)
Germany to be NATO's largest contributor to new €70 billion aid package for Ukraine over 2026-2027. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31397)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces launched a large-scale missile and UAV attack targeting Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian regions, with over 20 missiles and numerous Shahed drones reported. Ukrainian defense forces struck two major power substations in occupied Crimea, causing blackouts in Saki, Yevpatoria, and parts of Bakhchisarai district. Heavy fighting continues in Konstantinovka where Russian forces have approached the outskirts and proposed a tactical ceasefire which Ukrainian analysts assess as a trap.

points: Ukrainian defense forces conducted strikes on two major electrical substations in occupied Crimea during the night of July 5, causing widespread blackouts in Saki, Yevpatoria, and parts of Bakhchisarai district. (Source: @UkraineNow/82423)

Ukrainian air defense units engaged multiple Russian cruise missile groups over Chernihiv region and Shahed drones over northern Kyiv districts including Irpin and Bucha. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68584, @mon1tor_ua/68616)
Sumy Oblast Military Administration warned residents to avoid gas stations due to intelligence indicating planned Russian strikes on fuel infrastructure in the region. (Source: @UkraineNow/82429)
President Zelensky stated intelligence indicates Russia is preparing a new massive strike following US Independence Day and before the NATO summit in Ankara. (Source: @UkraineNow/82434)

Polish Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz ordered declassification of data on military aid to Ukraine for 2022-2026 following consultations with Prime Minister Donald Tusk. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23622)

Russian forces launched a large-scale missile barrage with approximately 20 rockets from multiple directions targeting Kyiv, Brovary, Boryspil, and surrounding regions, including launches from Chernihiv and Poltava oblasts. (Source: @eRadarrua/99867, @kpszsu/67472)

Russian strike UAV groups operated over southern Kyiv, Chernihiv region past Nizhyn and Talalaivka, Sumy region past Kyrykivka, and Kharkiv region past Lyubotin and Merefa. (Source: @kpszsu/67475, @kpszsu/67462, @kpszsu/67490, @kpszsu/67441)

Russian tactical aviation showed increased activity on eastern and northeastern fronts, creating threat of aviation weapon use against frontline areas in those sectors. (Source: @kpszsu/67483, @kpszsu/67489)
A Russian missile strike hit a gas station in Izium, Kharkiv region, destroying the operator building and fuel station, killing one man and injuring others. (Source: @UkraineNow/82427)

Russian forces continue offensive operations near Konstantinovka, Donetsk region, having approached the outskirts and conducting infiltration attempts while suffering significant losses from Ukrainian drone strikes. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23621)
The Russian Defense Ministry claimed Ukraine refused to retrieve bodies of its servicemen from the Konstantinovka area. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31398)

Russian jet-powered UAVs were detected heading toward Dnipro and Samara from the east, and two jet-guided UAVs operated in Zaporizhzhia region toward Ochakiv. (Source: @kpszsu/67495, @eRadarrua/99905)

Active battles continue in Konstantinovka, Donetsk region, where Russian forces have approached the outskirts, begun entrenching, and are conducting infiltration attempts into the city depths. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23621)

Russian units are attempting to consolidate positions near Ilinovka and Novodmitrivka to cut off movement and control across Konstantinovka, while Ukrainian pilots' strike-reconnaissance work hinders their entrenchment. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23621)

The Russian Ministry of Defense proposed a temporary ceasefire in Konstantinovka from 12:00 to 18:00 on July 6, which Ukrainian analysts assess as a deceptive trap to allow Russian forces to regroup and occupy the city. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23621)

Ukrainian forces maintain control of Konstantinovka despite difficult conditions, with Russian infantry suffering heavy losses from Ukrainian drone strikes during infiltration attempts. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23621)

Disorganized Ukrainian units were reported fleeing Konstantinovka northwest under pressure from Russian subunits, according to a Russian battalion commander speaking to TASS. (Source: @tass_agency/383862)

Multiple Russian cruise missile groups launched from Chernihiv and Poltava regions flew toward Kyiv, with approximately 20 rockets detected heading toward Brovary and Boryspil areas. (Source: @eRadarrua/99867, @kpszsu/67472)

Russian strike UAV groups transited Chernihiv region past Nizhyn and Talalaivka on southwestern courses toward Kyiv region, while Shahed drones operated over northern Kyiv districts including Irpin and Bucha. (Source: @kpszsu/67462, @kpszsu/67490, @mon1tor_ua/68584)

Ukrainian air defenses engaged four cruise missiles flying from Sumy region into Chernihiv region, and intercepted missiles over Kyiv districts including Zhulyany, Solomyanka, Troyeshchyna, Voskresenka, and Darnytsia. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68616, @mon1tor_ua/68601, @mon1tor_ua/68606, @mon1tor_ua/68609, @mon1tor_ua/68613)

Sumy region UAV group passed Kyrykivka on southwestern course, and another UAV group headed toward Konotop, while a cruise missile from Sumy region flew toward Poltava region. (Source: @kpszsu/67491, @kpszsu/67441, @mon1tor_ua/68619)
A ballistic missile threat from the south was announced and later cancelled for the northern front areas. (Source: @kpszsu/67479, @kpszsu/67481)

Ukrainian forces struck two major electrical substations in occupied Crimea on the night of July 5, causing blackouts in Saki, Yevpatoria, and parts of Bakhchisarai district. (Source: @UkraineNow/82423)
The governor of Sevastopol reported the city temporarily lost power due to an attack on infrastructure. (Source: @tass_agency/383863)
